name: Aarchid - AI Botanical Intelligence
description: Photograph a sick plant and get a diagnosis you can act on. Multimodal vision grounded by real-time research-augmented LLM reasoning instead of a confident guess. Built as co-creator: PM and engineer.
imageAlt: Aarchid landing page showing the AI plant diagnosis interface and digital twin positioning.

name: Hackmate - Co-Founder Matchmaking Platform
description: Helps solo founders find the co-founder they'd actually build with. Swipe-based matching shaped around real founder-discovery pain points, and iterated with the community it grew in.

name: KiteEdge - Portfolio Intelligence
description: Gives a retail Zerodha trader the analytics desk a fund gets: 43+ indicators, Monte Carlo VaR, ensemble forecasting, a NIFTY 500 screener, and a FIFO trade journal, all self-hosted. 50 API endpoints, plus Power BI export for anyone who'd rather live in a dashboard.

name: ExperimentHub - A/B Testing Platform
description: Lets a team run experiments it can trust on its own infrastructure, with deterministic variant assignment from a Rust MurmurHash3 core, so a user lands in the same bucket every time. Kafka event ingestion, a Python stats engine with sequential methods, and a realtime React dashboard, all tenant-scoped.
imageAlt: ExperimentHub results view for a concluded demo experiment, showing the statistical significance panel, variant performance table with lift, and confidence-interval and conversion-over-time charts.

name: DeskTasks - Desktop Task Widget
description: Puts the task list on the desktop itself, pinned behind every window instead of buried in another tab. Natural-language quick-add, recurring tasks, reminders, time tracking, and honest .ics/CSV/Markdown round-trips. Local-first and accountless, shipped for Windows and macOS with an offline-first companion PWA.
imageAlt: Three DeskTasks widget panels on a dark ground: the pinned task list, natural-language quick-add parsing a date, time and tag, and a filtered search.

name: Better-Half - Cycle-Aware Companion
description: Helps long-distance couples stay in sync when they can't read the room in person. Cycle phase, mood, and stress drive daily guidance for her, him, and us. Privacy is enforced at the database rather than the UI: 575 live RLS checks, offline-first, $0/month infra.
imageAlt: Three Better-Half phone screens: the daily log, the Today view with cycle phase and next-period estimate, and the shared Us view. Demo data only.

name: Customer Churn Analysis
description: Told the retention team which customers were about to leave, early enough to do something about it. A predictive model that surfaced at-risk users and cut monthly churn by ~15%.

name: TCS NQT Prep Hub
description: Gets a candidate through the TCS NQT without paying for a prep course: 424+ practice questions, 10 previous papers, quizzes, flashcards, and progress analytics. Installable as a PWA and fully usable offline.
imageAlt: TCS NQT Prep Hub dashboard showing topic progress, recent activity, and study metrics.

name: This Portfolio - Meta Case Study
description: Treated my own portfolio as a product: spec and success metrics before any code, then iterations driven by real feedback. Ships at 95+ Lighthouse, with the whole decision trail written up as its own case study.
imageAlt: Portfolio home page showing the Dhruv Singhal hero section and product-focused positioning.

name: Weekly Retro - Relationship Performance Review
description: Corporate performance-review theatre, applied to a relationship, entirely on purpose: log a week of small signals and a scoring engine assembles a shareable 12-slide review deck, trajectory and areas of assessment included. The joke is the premise, not the build. Local-first PWA on IndexedDB, zero backend, and 25 pinned reference cases keeping the scoring honest.
imageAlt: Weekly Retro in present mode, showing slide 4 of an auto-assembled 12-slide review deck alongside the full slide rail. Demo data only.

name: SKU-to-Storefront Pipeline
description: Takes a retail client from a bare SKU list to live WooCommerce products without anyone retyping a spec sheet: enrich, verify, human QA gate, then transformed CSVs and images pushed over REST. Zero LLMs in the product path, by design, so the same input always produces the same catalogue.

name: D2C Tech-Stack Scanner
description: Answers “what is this D2C brand actually running?” by walking their real storefront journey, home to collection to product to cart to checkout, in a live browser. Fingerprints every technology via Wappalyzer signatures plus a curated Indian D2C pack, reported to formatted Excel.
